name: Shallots
siboNotes: High fructan content makes shallots problematic for SIBO. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Use only the green tops if available - they're lower in fructans
Infuse oils with whole shallots then remove before serving
Start with tiny amounts (1 tsp) to test tolerance
Consider using shallot-infused garlic oil as alternative
alternatives: Fennel bulb for mild onion-like flavor
nutritionalHighlights: Provides small amounts of vitamin C
